requirements.heading: SRV Specification Changes
requirements.text: The SRV RRset 'protocol' (global) underscored node name SHOULD be registered in the IANA "Underscored and Globally Scoped DNS Node Names" registry [RFC8552].

requirements.heading: URI Specification Changes
requirements.text: As for the SRV RRset [RFC2782], the URI RRset global (highest- level) underscored node name SHOULD be registered in the IANA "Underscored and Globally Scoped DNS Node Names" registry [RFC8552].
